long_biography.plain_text:
At PacificDental Benefits, Randy Brecher was appointed president while continuing as chief financial officer. The dual remit placed him over both enterprise leadership and financial control. PacificDental's employees later transferred into a larger dental-benefits group after a corporate acquisition, marking a change in the business that had defined his early executive profile.

Brecher went on to hold senior vice-president and director positions at Liberty Dental Plan and led its Nevada plan as president. Outside business, he served as a director of USA Surfing before leaving the board. He is now retired from executive work.
